ic_name: USB4 (USB Implementers Forum, Intel Thunderbolt 3 base)

test_modes.name: Loopback (LT-LFPS)
test_modes.purpose: Lane loopback for high-speed BER characterization during link training.

test_modes.name: Compliance pattern
test_modes.purpose: Transmit defined compliance patterns for Gen 2 / Gen 3 PHY signal-quality measurement.

test_modes.name: Per-lane equalization
test_modes.purpose: Adaptive equalizer tuning + reporting per lane.

test_modes.name: PD compliance
test_modes.purpose: USB Power Delivery message-level compliance on CC pins.

spec_provided_observability.name: Counters config space
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-adapter performance + error counters readable by the Connection Manager.

spec_provided_observability.name: Router config space
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Topology + capability discovery for debug of the spanning tree.

error_detection_mechanisms: Transport-layer CRC + sequence checks on tunneled packets.
Path-setup validity checks in router config space (invalid hop ID / adapter).
Power Delivery contract error on CC pins.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: USB Power Delivery renegotiation on CC pins.

notes: USB4 debug/observability is structural: routers expose router/adapter/path/counters configuration spaces that the Connection Manager reads, plus SBU sideband events and TMU time-sync status. PHY-level compliance uses Gen 2 / Gen 3 compliance patterns and LT-LFPS loopback.
